claims: The seven runtime drafts decode equal to their immutable v1 Swift factory drafts and materialize to the same canonical definition digests.
Reviewed golden inputs and expected outcomes are stored in the mapping document independently of translator logic and are evaluated by Swift.
Contest portability CI checks out the exact contest-sw commit with persisted credentials disabled, verifies the complete corpus, and runs all generator tests with CONTEST_SW_ROOT set.
The emitted v2 envelopes remain source-derived drafts and do not imply sponsor approval, category or schedule completeness, catalog activation, or operator-policy support.
The 87 other records lack reviewed mappings in this converter; this is not a claim that xLog cannot support those contests.
